latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the skill for diagnosing frontline sales manager effectiveness with the CEB four-driver model.

- Assesses manager effectiveness using the CEB driver weights: Sales Innovation (29%), Coaching (28%), Selling (27%), Resource Allocation (16%).
- Checks management fundamentals with five binary gate questions before proceeding.
- Gathers and analyzes manager time allocation and team composition (star/core/laggard breakdown).
- Detects key anti-patterns such as democratic coaching in time spent across rep tiers.
- Generates a structured diagnosis report with driver scores, identified anti-patterns, and a concrete coaching time reallocation plan.
